# Skills Catalog (gzkit)

This catalog is the per-skill index for AGENTS.md § Skills. It is generated
from `.gzkit/manifest.json` by `gz agent sync control-surfaces`; do not
hand-author. Run `uv run gz skill list` for the live authoritative catalog
